description: §19.16.2 — deferred bodies run at the enclosing block's exit (fall-through), in reverse registration order (LIFO); the block form runs its statements in order as one unit. go() writes a, registers 1, 2, then the block {3,4}, writes b, falls off the end: trace = "ab3421".
rationale: §19.16.2: a deferred body is NOT executed where the `defer` appears; every deferred body registered in the block runs exactly once when control leaves the block, last-registered first. The block form `defer { … }` is one deferred body whose statements run in source order. So after `a` and `b` the exits run the block (3 then 4), then 2, then 1.
